page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top: large title block centred, in capitals (about 4 lines of title, then author line and name). Middle: a small italic block of Latin verse, about 4 lines, centred. Below: a centred device (faint woodcut, under the library stamp). Under the device: a short line "IESVS." and one italic line. Bottom: imprint, centred, "TIGVRI" and the printer's line with date. The library stamp is not transcribed.
page.notes: The title block is very faint and show-through from the reverse is present. The lines marked [?] and the top title words are my best reading and should be checked against the scan. The four italic verse lines in the middle and the line under the device could not be read letter by letter. The name "RODOLPHO GVALTHERO" (Rudolf Gwalther) and the Zurich imprint are inferred from the visible letters. The library stamp ("Bibliothek der Cantonal-Lehranstalten zu Zürich") is not transcribed.
